claim_boundary: Prospective policy and identity freeze only. Full local qualification is common cost, and Pareto dominance is a search rule to test rather than an assumed latency theorem.

cost_accounting.common_qualification: report all lowering and FSim wall time separately
cost_accounting.final_fused_feature_cost: charge every full-graph build and fused-TIR audit
cost_accounting.oracle_completion: report separately after prospective labels are exposed
cost_accounting.prospective_wave: charge cross-compile, FPGA correctness, timing and invocations

policy.action: FPGA correctness and latency are required for every non-dominated program; dominated programs are measured only in the later oracle-completion phase
policy.dominance: A dominates B iff A is no worse on every axis and strictly better on at least one axis
policy.eligibility: real lowering then three-seed FSim; all failures retained
policy.final_program_feature: cross-build final pretrained ResNet50 graph and aggregate exact fused-TIR logical LOAD+STORE over every matching Graph JSON occurrence
policy.stop: after the prospective Pareto wave, complete every remaining eligible program to construct an unbiased FPGA-correct pool oracle
policy.tie_break: candidate_id only for execution order, never for elimination
